definition: The task of automatically producing source code, typically from a natural language description, partial code, or specification.
details: Code generation is one of the most impactful practical applications of large language models, powering tools like AI coding assistants that suggest, complete, or write entire functions and programs.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. Think of it this way: The task of automatically producing source code, typically from a natural language description, partial code, or specification. And here is the clever part: Code generation is one of the most impactful practical applications of large language models, powering tools like AI coding assistants that suggest, complete, or write entire functions and programs. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. And that is Code Generation — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
